input.overview: Hot Fire Birds starts its two-ball play by completing any drop-target bank in the displayed order, which lights the captive-ball hole; lock there, then shoot the Release Captive Ball lane. Completing every bank in order lights Special at the top center lane. Lighting all top lanes and completing one ordered bank lights Extra Ball at the spot target. Either an ordered bank or all top lanes advances the Bonus multiplier.
input.simpleOverview: In Hot Fire Birds, complete a drop-target bank in order to light the captive-ball hole, lock a ball there, then shoot the Release Captive Ball lane for two-ball play. Complete every bank in order for Special at the top center lane. Light all top lanes and finish one ordered bank for Extra Ball at the spot target.
input.summary: Follow the lit order within one target bank instead of spraying the targets. That single-bank sequence lights the captive-ball lock and advances Bonus X. After locking, take the release lane immediately. Add the top lanes for Extra Ball, or repeat across every bank for Special.

steps.text: Choose one drop-target bank and knock down its targets in the displayed order.
Shoot the lit captive-ball hole to lock the first ball.
Shoot the Release Captive Ball lane to free the locked ball and begin two-ball play.
Complete additional banks in order; finishing every bank lights Special at the top center lane.
Take the top center lane while Special is lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Ordered drop-target bank
playfieldReferences.description: One of the banks whose lit sequence qualifies the captive-ball lock and advances Bonus X.

playfieldReferences.label: Captive-ball hole
playfieldReferences.description: Hole lit by an ordered bank completion; locks the first ball for two-ball play.

playfieldReferences.label: Release Captive Ball lane
playfieldReferences.description: Lane that releases the locked ball and begins two-ball play.

playfieldReferences.label: Top-center Special lane
playfieldReferences.description: Lane that collects Special after all target banks are completed in order.

playfieldReferences.label: Extra Ball spot target
playfieldReferences.description: Target that collects Extra Ball after all top lanes and one ordered bank are complete.
